title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - GPSLocation
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/GPSLocation. Physical GPS coordinates in ISO 6709:2008/Cor 1:2009 format. Per the source ontology, if 'altitude' is present then 'crs' must also be specified (not enforced structurally in this JSON Schema).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GPSLocation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

latitude.description: Property. Coordinate representing x horizontal position (latitude). Range is String or GPSUnit in the source ontology; modeled here as a string (e.g. decimal-degrees or ISO 6709 string form).

longitude.description: Property. Coordinate representing y horizontal position (longitude). Range is String or GPSUnit in the source ontology; modeled here as a string (e.g. decimal-degrees or ISO 6709 string form).

altitude.description: Property. For three-dimensional point locations, a value representing vertical position through either height or depth.
